sql:
SELECT 
    s.cds AS CharterNumber,
    AVG(s.AvgScrWrite) AS AverageScore,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(s.AvgScrWrite) DESC) AS Rank
FROM 
    satscores s
WHERE 
    s.AvgScrWrite > 499
GROUP BY 
    s.cds
ORDER BY 
    AverageScore DESC;
